_comment: Single source of truth for subscription plan entitlements. Read by the Next.js control plane (lib/subscription.ts) and the Python runtime (runtime/entitlements/plans.py) alike, following the same shared-file pattern as pricing.json. `null` means unlimited. Keep in sync with the Stripe products these tiers map to — the pricing page, the billing UI, and the gateway's quota enforcement all derive from this file, so a value changed here changes what customers are sold AND what they are actually allowed to do.
